nodes.label: Verte — reisbureau template
nodes.rationale: Maatwerk-tier travel template (green x terracotta, Fraunces). Archetype D: full-bleed destination photo hero; header starts transparent white-on-image and flips to solid light once scrolled past ~70% of viewport height. Quote band, 3-step op-maat process and travel-plan form.

nodes.label: Destination cards overlapping the hero edge
nodes.rationale: Signature layout: the destination card grid sits in a wrapper with negative top margin (margin-top clamp(-4.5rem...)) and higher z-index so the price-badged photo cards slide over the bottom edge of the full-bleed hero, visually stitching hero and content together.
